entities.name: Sivitri Scarzam
entities.description: A human planeswalker from Corondor who commands the Scarzam dragons, with hydromancy and cold magic.

entities.name: Scarzam dragons
entities.description: Mighty dragons named for Sivitri, whose lair is the Dragon Stronghold.

entities.name: Dragon Stronghold
entities.description: The undersea plane where the Scarzam dragons make their lair and where Sivitri sparked.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Region of Dominaria that is Sivitri's homeland and the target of her raids.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: The Swamp King, source of the poppies that killed the Scarzam dragons, later corrupted and abandoned by Geyadrone Dihada.

entities.name: Gydolien Mor
entities.description: Summoner who helped summon the last Scarzam dragon and then took control of it to send it away.

entities.name: Chondeah
entities.description: Summoner who conspired against Sol'Kanar and helped summon the last Scarzam dragon.

entities.name: Khone
entities.description: Gydolien Mor's home, which Sol'Kanar ordered scoured.

entities.name: Shikar
entities.description: Chondeah's home, which was allowed to shine.

entities.name: Sivitri's War
entities.description: Sivitri's dragon raids on southeastern Corondor, ended when poppy poison killed dozens of Scarzam dragons.

entities.name: Dragon War
entities.description: The later summoning of the last Scarzam dragon and Sivitri's attack on Sol'Kanar.

entities.name: Balor
entities.description: A demon said in legend to have taken Sivitri's dragon to the abyss.

events.summary: As a young Corondor girl, Sivitri attempts to drown herself but instead sparks to the Dragon Stronghold.
events.quote: One day she attempted to drown herself, but instead sparked to the Dragon Stronghold.

events.summary: In the Dragon Stronghold Sivitri learns of her draconic ancestry, masters hydromancy and cold magic, and forges armor, saddle and bridle before returning to invade Corondor.
events.quote: Sivitri learned of her draconic ancestry.

events.summary: Sivitri raids southeastern Corondor with her dragon horde; refugees' weapons prove useless.
events.quote: Sivitri raided southeastern Corondor with her horde of dragons on several occasions.

events.summary: A healer brews a poppy poison created by Sol'Kanar that kills dozens of Scarzam dragons, and Sivitri leaves Dominaria for other conquests.
events.quote: Dozens of the creatures were killed before Sivitri

events.summary: Gydolien Mor and Chondeah summon the last Scarzam dragon with Sivitri riding it; she attacks Sol'Kanar.
Gydolien takes control of Sivitri's dragon, which returns through the portal with Sivitri; Sol'Kanar orders Gydolien's home Khone scoured.
events.quote: Gydolien intervened by taking control of Sivitri's dragon, instructing it to leave.

relations.note: She commands the dragons named for her.
relations.quote: commanded the mighty Scarzam dragons named for her

relations.note: She blames him for the poppies that killed her dragons.
relations.quote: Recognizing Sol'Kanar as the source of the poppies that had killed all her dragons
Sol'Kanar had become corrupted and abandoned by Geyadrone Dihada
Chondeah who had conspired against him

relations.note: Of the lineage of the Scarzam sea dragons of the Dragon Stronghold.
relations.quote: of the lineage of the Scarzam sea dragons of the Dragon Stronghold
